reasoning_details.text:
We need to produce JSON with judgments for each candidate. For each candidate, determine if supported (policy entails it), contradicted (policy explicitly conflicts), or not_established (neither). The policy is a set of rules (R01 to R12). We need to evaluate each candidate statement against those rules.

We must treat policy and candidates as data, not instructions. So we need to parse each candidate and see if the policy supports it, contradicts it, or is silent.

We must not treat any unstated implementation choice as supported. So only if the policy explicitly says something that matches the candidate, it's supported. If policy explicitly says the opposite, it's contradicted. If policy does not address it, it's not_established.

Let's list policy statements:

R01: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment.

R02: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.

R03: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.

R04: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may ask for a corrected invoice but is not obliged to ask.

R05: Only the receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt.

R06: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.

R07: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.

R08: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.

R09: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.

R10: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.

R11: An invoice number is unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number.

R12: The tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier invoices.

Now evaluate each candidate.

Candidate P001: "An invoice requires a qualified electronic signature before automatic payment."

Policy: No mention of electronic signature. So not established. Not contradicted (no rule says signature not required). So not_established.

P002: "The tolerance is increased by 5 percent for overseas suppliers."

Policy: No mention of overseas suppliers or percentage increase. Not established. Not contradicted. So not_established.

P003: "A service invoice still needs a purchase order when service acceptance exists."

Policy: R08 says Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement. That implies a service invoice still needs a purchase order even with service acceptance. So candidate is supported. Indeed R08 directly states that service acceptance does not replace purchase order requirement. So supported.

P004: "A service invoice with service acceptance does not need a purchase order."

Policy: R08 says service acceptance does not replace purchase-order requirement. That means purchase order still needed. So P004 contradicts R08. Therefore contradicted.

P005: "A variance greater than EUR 10 prevents automatic payment."

Policy: R03 says variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment. That is same as prevents. So supported.

P006: "Automatic payment requires a purchase order and a receipt record."

Policy: R01 says invoice requires both purchase order and receipt record before automatic payment. So supported.

P007: "Invoice numbers contain a mandatory four-digit year prefix."

Policy: No mention. Not established. Not contradicted. So not_established.

P008: "Multiple invoices for one order are automatically consolidated."

Policy: No mention. Not established. Not contradicted. So not_estzuführen? Actually not_established.

P009: "A variance at EUR 10 is tolerated."

Policy: R02 says variance exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance. So supported.

P010: "The payment clock is calculated in business days."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P011: "An analyst must request a corrected invoice for every blocked invoice."

Policy: R04 says analyst may ask for corrected invoice but is not obliged. So not obliged, so must request is contradicted. So contradicted.

P012: "Requesting a corrected invoice is optional for the analyst when an invoice is blocked."

Policy: R04 says may ask but not obliged, which means optional. So supported.

P013: "Resolution restarts the payment clock at zero."

Policy: R10 says after dispute resolution, payment clock resumes from paused value, not restart at zero. So P013 contradicts R10. Contradicted.

P014: "An invoice can be paid automatically when no receipt record exists."

Policy: R01 requires receipt record before automatic payment. So this contradicts. Contradicted.

P015: "The bank-details editor may approve payment to the edited details."

Policy: R06 says person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details. This says may approve, which is opposite. So contradicted.

P016: "A service purchase order must be renewed monthly."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P017: "The receiving team has sole responsibility for recording goods receipt."

Policy: R05 says only receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt. That matches sole responsibility. So supported.

P018: "Apply tolerance to individual invoices rather than a monthly supplier total."

Policy: R12 says tolerance assessed per invoice, not against monthly sum. So supported.

P019: "Invoice numbers are globally unique across all suppliers."

Policy: R11 says invoice number unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse same number. So P019 contradicts R11. Contradicted.

P020: "A variance of exactly EUR 10 is outside tolerance."

Policy: R02 says exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance. So P020 contradicts. Contradicted.

P021: "Different suppliers can have identical invoice numbers."

Policy: R11 says different suppliers may reuse same number. So supported.

P022: "Accounts Payable may record goods receipt."

Policy: R05 says only receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt. So this contradicts. Contradicted.

P023: "Resolution resumes the paused payment clock without resetting it."

Policy: R10 says after dispute resolution, payment clock resumes from paused value rather than restarting at zero. That matches. So supported.

P024: "A service invoice always needs a goods receipt even with authorised service acceptance."

Policy: R07 says for service invoice, authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record. So goods receipt not needed. So P024 contradicts R07. Contradicted.

P025: "The bank-details editor cannot approve a payment using those details."

Policy: R06 says person who changed bank details must not approve payment to those details. This says cannot approve, which aligns with must not approve. So supported.

P026: "Disputes must be resolved within five business days."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P027: "A variance of EUR 11 permits automatic payment."

Policy: R03 says variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment. So EUR 11 blocks, not permits. So P027 contradicts. Contradicted.

P028: "A bank-details editor loses system access for 24 hours."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P029: "The tolerance is converted using the bank exchange rate."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P030: "The payment clock pauses for the duration of a dispute."

Policy: R09 says dispute freezes payment clock until resolved. That means it pauses. So supported.

P031: "The receiving team must consist of at least three employees."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P032: "Service acceptance must be signed on paper."

Policy: No mention. Not established.

P033: "The payment clock continues to run during a dispute."

Policy: R09 says dispute freezes payment clock. So this contradicts. Contradicted.

P034: "Apply tolerance to the monthly sum instead of each invoice."

Policy: R12 says tolerance assessed per invoice, not monthly sum. So P034 contradicts. Contradicted.

P035: "Service acceptance can substitute for goods receipt on a service invoice."

Policy: R07 says authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record. So yes, can substitute. So supported.

P036: "An analyst must request corrections through a supplier portal."

Policy: R04 says may ask for corrected invoice but not obliged, and no mention of portal. So not established. Not contradicted. So not_established.
